name: splabs-gate
description: A deterministic gate in front of every tool call Claude Code makes. Fixed rules decide: the action runs, is refused with a reply the model reads, or waits for you as Claude Code's own approval prompt. Every decision, and every yes or no of yours, is logged on your console at splabs.io/gate.

api_key.title: Gate key
api_key.description: A gate-only key from splabs.io, Settings, API Keys, + Gate-only key. It starts with psa_gate_ and works only on the gate.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: the gate decides and records, nothing is blocked (start here). enforce: refused actions do not run, held ones ask you.

egress_hosts.title: Allowed hosts
egress_hosts.description: Hosts the agent may contact without asking, comma-separated (for example api.example.com,docs.example.com). Leave empty for none.
